svg.title: Fine pixels and coarse tiles under a fixed palette
svg.desc: Top row: a photograph of a snake as the original, with the xterm 256-color palette dithered and not dithered, one color per pixel. Bottom row: the same photograph with one color per tile, as the 24-bit mean of each tile, dithered between tiles, and not dithered. Dithering looks close to the original on the fine grid but breaks the coarse tiles into conspicuous noise.
svg.text: Fine grid: xterm 256 colors, one color per pixel
Coarse tiles: xterm 256 colors, one color per 9 × 9 tile
